scope: Complete 16-bit PCM WAV from original-text requests; isolated acoustic FP16 increment uses identical FP32 GPT split-kv chunk=256, numerical reference inputs and replay draws/noise. Separate resource runs are not used for timing.
normalization: Signed int16 PCM divided by 32768, with no loudness/peak normalization. Complete PCM and speech excluding appended silence are both screened.
status_explanation: The benchmark intentionally retains replay_validation_failed because the original FP32 PCM tolerance fails; this comparison does not replace or relax it.

shared_process_experiment.scope: Resource experiment only; timings are not speed evidence. PCM is compared against the same FP32 GPT split256 and FP16 acoustic candidate in separate processes, not against FP32 acoustics.

both_fp16_natural_experiment.scope: Experimental FP16 GPT baseline attention plus FP16 acoustics; fresh NumPy random draws, not the FP32 replay workload, and no paired strict-equivalence or listening/ASR acceptance.
